articleTitle: Cointegration Analysis and ECM of Energy Consumption and Industrial Economic Growth of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: This paper analyzes the long-term equilibrium relationship between GDPI and TEC of China by using statistics data from 1953 to 2008. The research shows that there is one-way Granger-causality between the total energy consumption growth and industrial growth, the growth of the total energy consumption impacts on industrial economic growth, and it also shows that industrial economic growth benefits energy development, and the purpose of energy-saving can be achieved through technical innovation.

articleTitle: A Optimisation Algorithm with Data Analysis and Control Platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Current optimisation methods, especially stochastic methods, are short of intermediate data analysis and control. Moreover the intermediate data has rarely been interpreted into the knowledge useful for either optimisation itself or industry productions. In this paper, we proposed a new optimisation method featuring on the capability of intermediate data analysis and control without setting any computational burden on optimisation. The method makes use of the long Markov process whose concept is borrowed from that in the simulated annealing but meanwhile bypasses its inherent sequential nature by using the proposed conceptual pools to populate the generated solutions. Four simple optimisation problems were selected to investigate the validity of the new algorithm. The algorithm was also studied on a complex engineering problem by comparing with the simulated annealing. Results showed that the new algorithm was as robust as the simulated annealing algorithm but can achieve quicker convergence.

articleTitle: The Suggestion to Strengthen the Science Popularization to Enhance the Capacity of Sustainable Development of High-Tech Zone: Case Study of Hangzhou High-Tech Zone
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: After twenty-year development, national high-tech zones in China step into "the second entrepreneurship" which emphasizes on enhancing the capacity of independent innovation. In order to promote the sustainable development of high-tech zone, this paper studies the case of Hangzhou high-tech zone and analyzes the problems and difficulties in science popularization after the actual investigation, then gives suggestions and polices in the future work.

articleTitle: Urban-Rural Coordination Degree Modeling for Beijing City
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: A novel evaluating method is introduced in this research to better illustrate urban-rural land issues and accompanying connections with other subsystems in Beijing. Coordination degree is the key role in processing the evaluation, integrating a variety of indicators selected based on different subsystem orientation, including economic subsystem, social subsystem and environmental subsystem. The results display that Beijing is basically coordinated overall, but the economic system has a higher degree than the social and environmental system, which are generally applied with the reality. It is reasonable to conclude that, Land Coordination Degree Model designed in this research is highly trustable and feasible to evaluate urban-rural land status.

articleTitle: Optimized Design on Marketing Model of Tourism Destination from Perspective of Regional Wholeness
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Tourism destination is a comprehensive definition and the key factor of tourism competitive competence. The existing marketing modes have respective advantages and disadvantages, this paper aims at integrate them and puts forward an optimized design of marketing model, the public marketing model from the perspective of regional wholeness. The optimized model consists of three sub-systems and their interaction involves participation of all the stakeholders and contributes to the whole benefits and welfare of the destination.

articleTitle: Measuring Brand Overlap Using Optimal Error Rate Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: From the perspective of brand personality and using Optimal Error Analysis, we then develop a method to measure brand overlap. Using this method we then conduct an empirical analysis of brand overlap within China's the digital camera industry. Finally, by incorporating multidimensional analysis, we explore ways to further improve our method.

articleTitle: Optimization Based on Ant Colony-Genetic Algorithm in Oilfield Water Injection System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: This paper presents an algorithm of Ant Colony-Genetic to solve the optimization problem of oilfield water system. For the shortcomings of basic genetic algorithm, this paper has made a corresponding improvement to improve the global searching capability. Under the requirements of actual oil- field water injection system service, this algorithm is used to solve this optimization problem of oilfield water system, and the feasibility of this algorithm is verified by example.

articleTitle: No-Arbitrage and State Prices in Frictional Markets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: In this paper, we extend the martingale analysis of no-arbitrage pricing with transaction costs, bid-ask spreads and taxes. We establish the equivalence of a no-arbitrage condition for the existence of different shadow prices of certain optimal problems and obtain a characterization of state prices based on the absence of arbitrage.

articleTitle: Dimension Structure of Competency for Domestic City Commercial Banks Management
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: It compiles the competency questionnaires of the domestic city commercial banks management, 261 valid questionnaires are analyzed through the use of exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis. The result shows that the management competency model of domestic city commercial banks has three-dimensional structure, respectively is internal quality, relationship management and management skills, respectively is immanent quality including 4 items, relationship management including 6 items and management skills including 7 items. The research results can be on the basis of human resource management role for the management of domestic city commercial banks.

articleTitle: Impact on Software Development by Innovative Team Organization Form
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: In this paper, three different forms of team organization are proposed, according to the structural characteristics of the members of a team. As a sample, software production efficiency and quality a Service-oriented Architecture (SOA) project are presented by above three forms of organization. Finally, the result examines the rationality of innovative team organization form.

articleTitle: An Improvement Approach of Indoor Location Based on Radio-Map Using Wireless Local Area Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: In this paper, we present an improved approach of indoor location using Wireless Local Area Network. To reduce the influence from multi-path interference, we used a max filter to preprocess the original received signal strength indications. We also used a more conformable distribution to substitute the standard Gaussian distribution in indoor location system. Our experiments results show that the proposed method is effective.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on the Connotations and Impact of Green Procurement for Forest Product
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the Relationship between Employee Commitment and Turnover in the Equipment Manufacturing Industry of Shenyang
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Information Ecological Analyze of Application Plight of Urban Public Information Kiosk in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Urban public information kiosk is a kind of important devices which be used to provide information service for public. However , in recent years, while the promote process of urban public information kiosks in China, many negative phenomenon such as low participation rate, operation inconvenience, suffered frequent damage and so on are also arise. Analyzed by the perspective of the information ecosystem theory, this paper found that it is certain problem exists among interaction of information, information subject as well as the information environment which leads to above information ecological imbalance state. In order to achieve information ecological balance, government must play a leading role in the construction of urban public information database, public training providing, kiosk management strengthening, and transfer public information kiosks into the city's "digital windows" gradually.

articleTitle: Strategy Research for Further Application of E-Business in Pump Enterprises: Wenling Pump Enterprises as an Example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: This article analyzes the application situations of E-business in Zhejiang Wenling pump enterprises, and tries to propose some strategy suggestions for further application, which is hoped to be helpful for the development of e-business in Zhejiang pump enterprises.

articleTitle: Study on the Coupling Mechanism of Energy-Conversation in Chinese Buildings
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Through the analysis on the life properties of building energy-conversation, this paper explains the coupling between nodes and the rule of cohesion within nodes in the lifecycle of building energy conservation. The energy-saving chain of construction engineering is combined with the coupling concept of synergetics. With the influence degree of coupling factors between upstream and downstream of energy-saving chain as the coupling degree, author of this paper constructed the coupling degree model of upstream and downstream in the energy-saving chain of building engineering, and then used the coupling degree between upstream and downstream of two nodes in the energy-saving chain of building engineering to judge whether these two function systems can meet standard and then determine the possibility of disconnection in the energy-saving chain.

articleTitle: Study on Establishment of Armored Equipment PHM System based on aFMEA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: According to some shortcomings of armored equipment maintenance, such as 'surplus maintenance' and 'corrective maintenance', Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) technology which was brought forward by USA army was introduced. Aiming at an armored vehicle engine, augmented-Failure Mode and Effect Analysis(aFMEA) was proceeded. Analysis on failure symptoms and sensor installation was introduced into the traditional FMEA method, aFMEA is no longer limited to static analysis on failure mode and effect. Then, the structure of armored equipment PHM system was established, its function module was designed concretely. The investigation and discussion on establishment methods of armored equipment PHM system was proceeded.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation for the College Financial Risk Based on Fuzzy Mathematics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: On account of the financial risk, with which is be faced in the process of the university education funding channels. It expounds the background and reason of the financial risks in colleges and universities, analyzes its components, proposes the principle of evaluation system, sets evaluation system, and explores the feasibility of carrying through fuzzy synthesis evaluation, establishes the mathematical model of fuzzy synthetic evaluation, and evaluates more that's could be evidence for the basis of the college financial management work.

articleTitle: A Communication-Efficient Threshold Monitoring Method for Distributed Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: This paper considers the problem of how to reduce communication cost over threshold monitoring in distributed system. An Event-based Threshold Dynamically Assign (ETDA) method is proposed in this paper, which considers the situation in reality that the data distribution in remote monitor nodes changes dynamically. Therefore, we set different threshold value in each remote monitor node based on their object value, and adjustment is taken place when any event (local threshold violation) occurs or a time window is exceeded. The time window is used to guarantee that local threshold assignment will not happen too frequently. We also consider that there are two kinds of messages in the monitoring system, they are pull and push messages. We found that when the communication cost of pulling is the same as the communication cost of pushing, ETDA achieves better performance than the UTA algorithm which set local threshold uniformly and statically. Experimental evaluation shows the efficiency of ETDA on reduce communication over threshold monitoring in distributed system.

articleTitle: A Distributed Management of Massive Remote Sensor Data Using Open Source Software
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The efficient organization and access method of massive remote sensor images face great challenges for the sending of more satellites. The hybrid way to manage massive images by using RDBMS and DFS is proposed, which integrates the computing and data management facilities on open source software. The architecture is introduced and system is developed. Some applications on the system are presented.

articleTitle: On the Global Convergence of Nonmonotone Trust Region Algorithms for Nonsmooth Optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The classical trust region algorithm was extended to the nonsmooth minimization problem successful by Qi and Sun. Combining the trust region algorithm of Qi and Sun with the nonmonotone technique. Xi, Wu and Zhou presented a nonmonotone trust region algorithm for the unconstrained nonsmooth optimization problems where the objective function is locally Lipschitzian, and the local convergence results was established. This paper prove that our nonmonotone trust region algorithm is globally convergent.

articleTitle: Game Theory-Based Research on Revenue Allocation Model for Stakeholders' Harmonious Integration of Construction Project
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: It depends on the revenue allocation that the stakeholders of construction project can cooperate harmoniously or not for it can reduce the conflict among the stakeholders and construction resources if the income can be distributed reasonably.With the use of game theory, this paper has created a rational revenue allocation model and determined the non-egalitarian distribution coefficient on the basis of former work. And it concluded the conditions of harmonious construction income distribution and does an application of the model.

articleTitle: Dynamic Supergames on Rectangle Lattice Based on Four Person Team Games
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: In this paper two classes of large supergames, i.e., infinitely repeated games played by many players on 2-dimensional rectangle lattice are studied. Each person located on the vertices of the lattice plays four 4-person team games or 4-person 2-pairs team games simultaneously with her neighbors. Under the conditions of the pre-specified updating rules and the transition probabilities, the strategy process forms a Markov Chain. The formula of invariant measures which represent the long-run equilibrium plays with symmetric payoffs are obtained.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Performance Evaluation of Enterprise Knowledge Management Based on Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research of Lung Cancer Screening Algorithm Based on RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: In this paper, a radial basis neural network (RBFN) for lung cancer screening algorithm is presented. Because of the learning characteristics of the radial basis neural network (RBFN), it has been selected to train the samples, which are the lung cancer examples, and then extracts the internal relations between the pathogenic factors and inducing lung cancer, and eventually it generates empirical function and forecasts the new samples. Advantage of this algorithm is that during the RBFN construction process, training function adopts the linear least square method (LLS) and the gradient descent hybrid learning algorithm, to optimize the training process and the screening results.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of Financing Problems of Listed Companies on the GEM
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Economically Designed SVSSI Xbar Control Chart
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: A SVSSI (special variable sample size and sampling interval) X̅ chart that uses two sampling intervals and three sample sizes has been shown superior to the traditional VSI and VSSI X̅ charts. The economic model for a SVSSI X̅ chart is developed. The performance indexes of the SVSSI X̅ chart ATS, AATS, ANSS, and ANOS are derived by employing the Markov chain approach. The cost function is derived. Numerical example is used to compare the economic performances of VSI, VSSI, and SVSSI X̅ charts. The results show the superiority of the developed model. The genetic algorithm is employed to search the optimal solution of the economic design for the particular process.

articleTitle: The Influence of Regional Culture and Value on the Flow of Chinese Young Talents
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The influence of regional culture and values on the Chinese human resource market has been steadily increasing, but unconsciously. In recent years scholars have studied a variety of phenomena that imply a shift-away from classical explanations of talent flow and human resource patterns. This has led to the coining of some new terms and concepts, such as "Ant Tribe". This tendency towards the study of culture and values is directly related to the Theory of Scenes from the Chicago School of Sociology. In this paper, we apply the Theory of Scenes to Chinese regional human resource management. First, we review the relevant theories and the current situation in China. Then, we construct a cultural framework to study 375 counties in China. After that, we conduct a statistical analysis on the flow of Chinese young talents using Stepwise Regression model. At last, we prove our hypotheses. Some policy suggestions are given in the end based on conclusions made above.

articleTitle: A Study on the Motivators of Transnational Operations of Chinese Commercial Banks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: When entering the 21st century, the foreign assets and the number of oversea agencies of Chinese commercial banks increasing constantly, and its level of internationalization become higher. This paper relies on Dunning's eclectic theory (OLI Model) as a framework to explain the motivators of transnational operation of Chinese commercial banks. Empirical results show that: profitability and international experience of commercial banks, the direct investment abroad, the level of industrialization and income and banking regulatory environment of host country (region) in all have a significant impact on cross-border operations of commercial banks in China. It is further reveals that in order to expand its cross-border operation activities, Chinese commercial banks should to better use its ownership, location and internalization advantages.

articleTitle: Public Investment of the Governments and Macro-Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Public investment policy should pursue for increase in per capita income instead of increase in income. The objective is affected by some constraints, which involve taxation, corruption, labor productivity, and so forth. Empirical analysis shows the effectiveness of the public investment model. The model is able to provide reliable reference for governmental economic decision.

articleTitle: Based on Improving Students' Self-Learning Ability Sports Physiology Multimedia Experimental Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: This paper adopts literature, mathematical statistics, experiment and the scale method, takes experimental research to the multimedia Sports Physiology teaching. The main results of the study demonstrate: multimedia technology brings colorful picture, interesting animation and a lot of advanced information, which makes Learning forms diversity and enrichment and arouse the students' novelty and interested, and finally set up the students self-learning ability.

articleTitle: A Cellular Automaton Model for Two Competitive Populations with Allee Effect and Overcrowding Effect
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Cellular automata (CA) have shown to be a valuable approach in ecological modeling, in particular when dealing with local interactions between species and their environment. In CA model, a global spatial pattern emerges through the evolution of interaction at a local scale. A cellular automata model for two competitive populations with overcrowding effect and Allee effect in a patchy environment has been developed. Having discussed the influence of the two effects on spatial pattern and dynamical complexity of two competitors, five primary results are given. First, overcrowding effect can produce the cricoids waves in space and chaos in time as well as single population model. And suitable increasing the colonization parameter of population produced the wave may shorten period of the spatial wave availably, also can vary its shape and is conducive to self-organization of system; Second, overcrowding effect of a competitor not only change complexity of two competitors but also influence their persistence in competitive system. But when its intensity exceeds some threshold, the complexity of two populations disappears suddenly and system will become stable. Third, the period of the wave caused by the overcrowding effect of the superior competitor is longer than the period of the wave caused by the overcrowding effect of the inferior. Fourth, Allee effect may not vary complexity of two populations until its intensity exceeds some threshold. In addition, extinction or invasion of some competitor may affect the dynamical complexity of original system significantly.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Environmental Effects of FDI in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The effect of foreign investment on six pollutants such as industrial polluted water, and sulfur dioxide is investigated with the regression model. The result shows that there isn't significantly negative correlation between the FDI and pollution emission, which is contrary to the popular hypothesis so called pollution haven. The environmental effect of FDI notably varies among different regions, which isn't negative in East China, while which is negative in central region and in West China. Improving the quality of introducing FDI and strengthening environmental protection are the effective way to inducing environmental pollution of FDI.

articleTitle: A Curriculum Scheduling System Based on Pooling Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Curriculum scheduling is an important and complicated work in schools. It's a complex problem to be resolved with multiple constraints. So to solve the problem is of great importance for teaching programming. In this paper, we mainly discussed the timetable problem of middle and high schools in teaching management. Investigated and studied the algorithm existed. Deserted the complex algorithm does not fit into the reality, while synthesized and developed the algorithm that fits into the reality to form the feasible algorithm, the pooling algorithm based on priority. The method was tested with real-world data sets and the result was satisfactory. The algorithm is reasonable and easy to be utilized.

articleTitle: Research on Flow and Pollutant Diffusion at the Fen River Entrance into Yellow River
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to find the variation of pollutant concentration field and its impact on water intake of the Fen River entrance into Yellow River. A 2-D water hydrodynamic and quality model was used to simulate flow and variation of the pollutant concentration field. There will be a backwater in tributaries when the water in Yellow River flow into Fen River. The COD concentration decreased significantly at the mouth of the Fen River into the Yellow River. The water quality fit class III and ⅴat North Zhao water intake in normal year(P=50%) and dry year(P=75%). The pollution area of lower reach is long and narrow in these years because the obstruction of central shoal. The flow path should be approximately 2.3km,2.9km in normal year(P=50%) and dry year(P=75%) to keep COD concentration in class III.

articleTitle: The Design of Dynamic Workflow Based on Document Flow System
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Traditional workflow decompose work into well defined tasks and roles,executed and monitorred by means of some regulations and procedures in order to control and coordinate the execution of those complicated activties in effect and improve the management level and competitive strength of enterprce. Traditional workflow technology defines a series of nodes rules ,process instance at run time in accordance with the transfer of these rules,but the rules can not be dynamically modified and lack of dynamic and adaptive. Based on traditional workflow ,this thesis optimize it for supporting a dynamic modification and focus on the support of dynamic modification strategy, dynamic modification operation.To prove the dynamic adaptability of workflow, dynamic workflow will be applied on decument flow system.

articleTitle: Forecast of Non-Performance Loan Ratio of Chinese State-Owned Commercial Bank
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The ratio of NPLs (non-performance loan) is one of the important indexes of assessing the security of credit assets, as well as it is an essential financial indicator to overall strength in commercial banks. In this paper we establish a time series model for the ratio of NPLs of Chinese state-owned commercial banks, taking the statistical data of the NPLs from 2002 to 2010 as an example, basing on the Eviews and time series analysis method. Taking use of this model to do a forecast, we get a conclusion that it is effective for this model to forecast the ratio of NPLs of Chinese state-owned commercial banks.

articleTitle: The Study of One Online Social Network Based on Structure and Evolution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Social networks became more and more important as subject of research in recent years. In this paper, a study of one Online Social Network, namely "17salsa-net" (www.17salsa.com) which is one of the biggest online social networks that providing services for salsa dancers and salsa fans in China, had been made to lay out a systematic analysis of network properties and evolution factors. Most key properties like degree distribution, clustering coefficient have been included. The study of this online social network evolution is based on the movement of network size and the roles of nodes. From these we can get the features of 17salsa-net and clear about the development of this group which members like salsa in China.

articleTitle: Influence of Producer Services on Regional Innovation Capability in China: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Although some documents deal with the impacts of producer services on regional innovation capability, relative empirical studies are rarely found in China. The relationship between producer services and innovation capability of state-level hi-tech development zones is empirically studied with principal component analysis and correlation analysis respectively, and it is proved that producer services have positive impacts on regional innovation capability. Therefore, to improve regional innovation capability in China, it is an effective way to strive to develop producer services.

articleTitle: Supply Chain Coordination under Revenue-Sharing Contract with Sales Effort Effect
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Consider a two level supply chain consisting of a supplier and a retailer which faces a stochastic demand influenced by retailer's sales effort. Before the sales season, the retailer has to decide both the ordering quantity and the level of the sales promotion at the same time. We first analyze the reason why the traditional revenue-sharing contract can't coordination the decentralized supply chain, then we provide a new contract which is a combined contract about sales cost sharing based on revenue-sharing. Proved that the combine contract can coordination the supply chain when the way of the sales effort effect is in product, at last we do a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Glocal Computing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Cloud Computing is catching more attention around the world with its excellent features in providing the services and advantages in economy both for the end-users and Cloud providers. However, due to lack of enough resources, Cloud vendors currently can only provide general resources and services, like computing as a service but not suitable for research on specific domain. Grid Computing, on the other hand, excels in assembling domain resources but is more complicated for use. In this paper, we propose Glocal (Global local) Computing based on these two technologies, aiming to promote resource sharing globally and coordinated problem solving locally at ease. Analysis shows that Glocal Computing can promote resource sharing and reuse and well support collaborated problem solving.

articleTitle: A Prototype of Emergency Management Information System Using GIS Technologies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Emergency management information system is one kind of information systems that concentrates its functions on assisting emergency response tasks with the integration of computer science and geographical information science technologies. This paper proposes and demonstrates the functions of a prototype of the emergency management information system, including the system architecture, data sources, database design and other components. Then the paper mainly introduces the plotting methods of the prototype and gives several different plotting examples dealing with the emergent events. The achievements of the research work can be applied to build emergency management information systems for different purposes in different governmental levels. The system can greatly help the emergency management agencies to deal with many types of emergent events and reduce the loss of life and property.

articleTitle: Biological Entity Boundary Detection Using ME Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The maximum entropy model as a statistical method is effectively used in many fields. It has many features: for example, subtle features can be controlled, reusable, simple and so easy to understand and so on. This model was first introduced during the sentence segmentation. In this paper, an example of the introduction of the concept of maximum entropy model, about the maximum entropy model was applied to biomedical text sentence split. In addition, compared to the general sentence segmentation to the ME model, to illustrate the advantages of the introduction of maximum entropy model.

articleTitle: The Application and Research of the Spanning Tree in the Project Based on Database
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The first level of material's classification information by means of tree structure is added up to thousands of kinds, and dozens of levels in depth. Therefore, it is rather hard to make the spanning tree. By comparing of three methods of spanning tree, by using the median compositor cardinal number, recursive method, loop method, it is found that the efficiency of their existence spanning tree is not high, and the depth of spanning tree is restricted and so on. This thesis puts forward a strategy by which material's classification information is read in a database in advance, and then sorts this information in the database. Finally based on the code of the ranking information, the spanning tree is formed by means of constructing tree algorithm. The result of the experiment shows that the strategy not only resolves the limi-tation of tree structure in level and depth, but it also improves the efficiency of the spanning tree.

articleTitle: Cultural Impact on Human Resistance - A Study of Companies Implementing Knowledge Management Software
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Many organizations actively consider implementing technologies like Portals, Product lifecycle management and custom built Knowledge Management software. A successful Knowledge management implementation involves setting up the right process and managing the people in the organization to share their knowledge in the process. This paper looks into challenges involved in people sharing their knowledge and the resistance to change from a individual centric to enterprise centric knowledge management. A study is conducted to understand the reasons and factors behind resistance to change in people involved in adopting a Knowledge Management software application in their organization. This research investigates the relationship between cultural background and its impact on the degree of resistance and the expressive nature of resistance. The need for a culture specific approach towards implementation of knowledge management applications in India is investigated and discussed. This study intends to incorporate the learning towards a definition of a comprehensive software implementation methodology.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Moderating Roles of Gender and Organizational Level between Work Stress and Job Satisfaction among Chinese Hospitality Employees
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence Factors on Sludge Wall Slip
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Wall slip behavior of sludge was studied experimentally by using a rotational rhehometer with parallel plate fixtures and checking the possible influence factors on sludge wall slip based on the gap dependence of the stress/ strain data. In the steady shearing flow it was found that there seems to be no critical shear stress for the onset of slip of sludge, while concentration is the important influence factor to sludge wall slip. In the oscillatory shear flow experiments, we analyze the total wave. While strain r=0.68, stress amplitude decreases with the time, while strain r=0.1, the stress amplitude remains constant. The stress sweep under the three gaps was done on the sludge of different angular frequency and temperature. In the previous stage, shear stress coincides better under the different angular frequency in the linear region and nonlinear region, somewhere in the nonlinear area it appears bifurcation, but the shear stress and strain are not constant in the bifurcation point. In a certain temperature range, gap dependence occurs, but the bifurcation point is almost same. It indicates that the wall slip relates to strain, angular frequency and other factor, the temperature of its impact is negligible.

articleTitle: A New Algorithm for Stable Communication in Wireless Emergency Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Emergency communication has been intensively investigated for solving suddenly-occurred events of public safety. Wireless network can play an important role of information acquisition and command decision-making in disaster areas, so a new Wireless Emergency Communication (WEC) algorithm is proposed in this paper. This algorithm possesses the characteristics of quick, stability, low energy and high reliability. The test results show that wireless emergency network adopting this algorithm can achieve the optimal stable communication.

articleTitle: An Analysis Framework for Enterprise Knowledge Integration Based on WSR System Methodology
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Based on reviews on existing knowledge integration researches, the paper introduces a WSR system methodology along with a three dimensional analysis framework comprising three elements in knowledge integration: the Wuli, Shili and Renli. The objective factors and the behavior-based human factors in the process of knowledge integration are discussed from multiple perspectives of Wuli, Shili and Renli. The paper provides a theoretical foundation and guiding principle for promoting effective knowledge management.

articleTitle: On Transmission Mechanism from Social Security to Consumption Using First Order Difference Function
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Social Security plays an important role in "social power systems" as well as in "social stability system". This paper selected the two variables of social security and the consumption, made analysis using the tool of first-order differential equation. By model analysis, we have concluded that (1) different levels of social security will affect inhabitant expected income, further to change the consumption level. Under the constant external conditions, the expected income increase, the consumption level will be promoted more. If the social security reduced, it will reduce the expected income, further lower the people's consumption levels. (2) the different models have varied effects. If the reaction coefficient is between 0 and 2, social security model is most stable and can maintain the level of consumption in a good level. If the reaction coefficient out the range 0-2, it will lead the social security-consumption model into instable state. And the instability, both increase and decrease out the range 0-2, will increase the difficulty of promoting consumption level.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of BIOS for Godson-3A Interconnections
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The hardware design of Godson-3A processor adopts the scalable distributed multi-core structure which is based on a 2D mesh. It can make use of multi-chip interconnection to construct a unified topology structure for board level or system level. This kind of interconnected system can't achieve entirely by hardware design, and it also needs the reasonable design of the BIOS and upper software. As the only bridge between hardware and software, the BIOS plays an important role in the computer system. In this paper, we introduce the two-level scalable architecture implemented inside Godson-3A, and discuss the realization of software routing configuration mechanism by the crossbar switch in detail. Based on the above analysis, we analyze the design and implementation of BIOS in a CC-NUMA system composed by multiple processors with support of Godson-3A hardware design, and in a larger NCC- NUMA system formed by multiple CC-NUMA systems.

articleTitle: The Research on the Risks & the Countermeasures of the Distributed IT Projects
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Nowadays, more and more large IT projects need to unit several entities to accomplish together, which forms project-oriented and geographically distributed virtual organizations and leads to new distributed risks. This article first gives a definition of the distributed IT project (DITPs), then based on the literature, studies the risk characteristics, risk scope, risk factors of DITPs, and finally studies the developing process of the DITPs and gives a risk management process of iterative and incremental agile development of the whole lifecycle of the DITPs from a few respects such as the set of an organization goal of win-win, the project development of grading iteration and increment, the introduction supervisory mechanism of a third party, and the establishment of study mechanism of risk management.

articleTitle: Research on the Supporting Role of Information Integration to Supply Chain Management in Large Retail Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Information flow plays a very important role in supply chain management and provides a support for smooth operation of the supply chain. Large retail enterprises as the core enterprises play a central role in the construction of supply chain, and they need to centralize, analyze and process the scattered information in enterprises at very node and finally form integrated information stored in a database to provid convenience for all partners' reference and interpretation and coordinate the relationship among all parties at the same time. Integrated information play a strongly supporting role in pruchasing link, logistics link, consumption link in the whole chain, which improves the comprehensive competitiveness of the whole supply chain.

articleTitle: Game Analysis of Breaking the Dilemma of Knowledge Sharing between Organizations
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: A lot of factors will leads to the difficulties rather than dilemma for knowledge sharing between organizations. It is "free-ride" due to knowledge spillovers that lead to the dilemma. The knowledge leaders can not get complete compensation. On another side, the "free-ride" is not full free. Because the knowledge followers need to pay for the cost of information searching, self-learning for knowledge. Therefore, there should be an equilibrium price for knowledge leaders and followers to share knowledge. And then, a game model is constructed to interpret deeply the mechanism of dilemma. Based on this, we give some recommendations about how to break the dilemma.

articleTitle: The Pricing of Credit Risk under Reduced-Form Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Based on the model of Duffie & Singleton (1999), this paper constructs a simpler reduced-form model of credit risk pricing. The result shows that, the model largely simplifies the calculation process of the traditional reduced-form model without affecting calculation accuracy. Lastly, empirical studies on credit spreads of risk bonds are made using the data of the Chinese bond market, which fairly confirms the rationality of the theory.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Geospatial Information Database in Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: SNS (social network service) is becoming more and more popular on the web, and it is even more so for Mobile Internet browsing. The huge success of foursquare on the web shows that introducing LBS (location based service) to mobile Internet is promising. With LBS, mobile device (client) needs to commit user's location information as a request to the remote server (server). The server receives the request and handles it, and then it sends the specified map data back. In this model, a powerful central server is needed. The paper focuses on promoting efficiency of the model by designing a new geospatial information file-oriented database with GeoML (Geospatial Information Markup Language) which is an optimized storage process, embedded on each client to create a P2P network on the mobile Internet.

articleTitle: Evpool: New Power Management Framework for Data Centers
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Nowadays, increasing importance has been attached to power management in modern data centers. A lot of solutions have been produced to reduce power consumption without producing an effect on quality of service. One common way is to associate with virtualization technology that has been widely used in data centers. This is due to not only its features of reliability and ease of management,but also its contribution to power management and saving. Based on these features, we present Evpool architecture to reduce power consumption in data centers using virtualization technology. Evpool architecture can manage resource allocation more reasonably and intelligently, and improve resource utilization through a two-layer system distributed on single and multiple servers. We supply web service through virtual cluster, using 1998 world cup web site trace to verify the performance of our architecture. The results shows that 5.5% energy can be saved when distributing Evpool on the small cluster in our experiment.

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Capturing Healthy Image Data in Hospital Legacy Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: In hospitals, there are usually many legacy equipments and software systems, which may not provide standard interface for integration or even do not have its own API for outside accessing. This makes it very hard to integrate those legacy systems with health information system. It becomes a big challenge for health information integration if you want to provide a total Health Information System for hospitals. To solve this problem, this paper designs an effect and flexible health images data capture methods and apply it in certain hospitals. It uses windows Hook API to capture the output data or system operation behavior and submit to health information system. Finally, they can be renewed by a special algorithm developed by us.

articleTitle: Computer Data Mining and Exploration of the Audit Practice
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Today's fast developing modern information technology not only has a great impact on the social and economic activities but also more importantly has caused the innovation of modern auditing technology. In order to keep pace with the development of modern audit, the author adopted the method of computer data mining to analyze large quantities of data collected from the audited corporate, and work out the feature of the business data collected from the corporate. This could reveal whether the audited corporate has any anomalies, which in turn will help to reduce the quality problems and audit risks in modern audit.

articleTitle: EFSM Task Scheduling Model Research in the SOA Integration Platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The goal of the Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) integration platform was to solve the integration and data exchange about multiple, used XML data exchange as a message. According to three kinds of data exchange in the SOA integration platform, This paper put forward the Evaluation and Four - queue scheduling Model (EFSM), and gave out the scheduling algorithm of thought. The grid computing Min - Min algorithm was improved that combined with actual situation for the forwarding task scheduling task bottleneck, tested eight business types in the warehouse management system of logistics enterprises and e-commerce system integration, proved task scheduling model and algorithm for the SOA integration platform was feasible, summarized the problems and the further improvement ideas.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Empirical Studies on Influences of Managerial Ownership on Firm Performance: On the View of Management Buyout
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Eliminating Cycles in Model Net
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Model Net is a graphical model used to represent and analyze the static structure of the model bases. Compared to other models, model composition method based on model net can not only greatly improve the efficiency of model composition, but also find out all the potential composite models for a given decision problem. However, the model net simplification and model composition algorithms may work improperly in practical applications for the reason that a model net constructed based on the concept of generalized data type matching may contain cycles. This paper aims at how to eliminate the cycles existing in a model net. We first introduced a concept of importance factor of an edge in a model net, and then worked out a method to eliminating cycles.

articleTitle: An Improved Bounding Cube Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The Bounding Cube algorithm used in wireless sensor networks depends greatly on the known nodes. When the number of known nodes is limited, the communication range of the unknown node is only decided by the intersection range of known nodes, which will reduce the positioning precision. This paper presents an improved algorithm. After acquiring the communication range of unknown nodes, you can use it to update the communication range of the other unknown nodes. By constantly updating the range, the unknown nodes will be gradually reduced. Thus, with the limited number of known nodes, we can take advantage of the unknown nodes to reduce the estimated communication range of other unknown nodes and improve the location accuracy.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on Upgrading International Green Competitiveness of Export Manufacturing Enterprise in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on the Recognition Model of Network Power
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: This paper designs and makes a questionnaire based on a deep interview, and analyzes those data by SPSS11.5, then constructs recognition model of the network power by EFA, on basis of these, it tests the validity of recognition factors and the reliability of recognition model by CFA empirical study and Cronbach'a coefficient. Results show that coercive power, information power and effect power are three main factors in identifying network power.

articleTitle: Principals of Trust in Internet Security and Websecure Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Trust and security are key enablers of the information society. Trust is an important aspect of decision making for Internet applications and particularly influences the specification of security policy. It addresses issues on who is authorised to perform actions as well as the techniques needed to manage and implement security in the applications. Trust relates to belief in honesty, truthfulness, competence, and reliability. The significance of incorporating trust in distributed systems is that trust is an enabling surety of good transaction. Its inclusion will enable Internet commerce and seamless, secure agent based applications. This paper investigates trust in relation to security in internet transactions; it specifically deals with different authentication schemes, Encryption, Trust in the websecure environment.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Video Stabilization by Sparse and Low-Rank Matrix Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract:

by Bo Gao, Ziming Kou, Zemin Jing
in the Proceedings of the 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management, May 2011, pp. 1-5

This paper contains substantial duplication of original text from the papers cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original authors and/or paper titles) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following articles:

"RASL: Robust Alignment by Sparse and Low-rank Decomposition for Linearly Correlated Images"
by Yigang Peng, Arvind Ganesh, John Wright, Wenli Xu and Yi Ma
in the Proceedings of the 23rd IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition, June 2010, pp. 763–770

"Video Stabilization Based on a 3D Perspective Camera Model"
by Guofeng Zhang, Wei Hua, Xueying Qin, Yuanlong Shao, Hujun Bao
in The Visual Computer, Volume 25, Number 11, November 2009, pp. 997-1008


This paper presents a novel approach to stabilize video sequences based on low-rank matrix decomposition. Compared to previous methods which are based on simplified models, our stabilization system can work in situations where significant depth variations exist in the scenes and the camera undergoes large translational movement. We formulate the stabilized frames as a low-rank matrix. This allows us to precisely control the smoothness by decomposing low-rank matrix. By taking advantage of the sparseness, our optimization process is very efficient. Instead of recovering dense depths, we use approximate geometry representation and analyse the resulting warping errors. We show that by appropriately constraint warping error, visually plausible results can be achieved even using planar structures. A variety of experiments have been implemented, which demonstrates the robustness and efficiency of our approach.

articleTitle: A Diagnosis Method for Water-Steam System of Power Plant Based on Credibility Theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: In view of the uncertain relationship between faults and symptoms in the water-steam system of power plant, this paper proposed a fault diagnosis method based on credibility theory. A fuzzy diagnosis model which is practical and effective was constructed by describing the issues of knowledge representation, choice of control mechanism and construction of uncertain algorithm. Simultaneously, in order to diminish diagnosis errors, this paper proposed a new setting method of rule confidence for credibility rule and made this diagnosis method closer to experts' thinking.

articleTitle: Tracking Error Portfolio Problem with WCPLM1 and Weights Constraints
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Motivated by the topics of active portfolio management payed close attention by many researchers and the fact that there exists rare explicit approach in robust portfolio literature. We propose a robust expectation maximization active portfolio model subject to the worst-case 1-order lower partial moment risk and multiple weights constraints in this paper. We first explore the explicit solution of the proposed model. And then we compare the efficient frontier of the proposed model with the classical mean-variance tracking error model. Some new and interesting results are found in the comparisons.

articleTitle: Higher Education Curricula for Services Science
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: A growing number of universities are offering curricula that are labeled as Services Sciences and/or Services Engineering or that are actually oriented to Services Sciences. We here review their contents, by a specific taxonomy of competences, founded on a Delphi research. A key of Services Sciences and/or Services Engineering curricula is the overlap between a service oriented concept of IT and the organizational analysis of business processes. To better exemplify a real world approach we analyze the case of University of Pavia that launched a Master of Science Curriculum in 2006. First in Europe, it integrates a strong background on enterprise systems with a practice of a model driven approach to the design and implementation of business processes and related IT services.

articleTitle: DB: A Developed 3D Positioning Algorithm in WSN Based on DV-Hop and Bounding Cube
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: In this paper, we come up with a new algorithm for node localization in three-dimensional wireless sensor networks, DB. Based on the two well-known algorithms, DV-Hop and Bounding Cube, DB uses the distance of known nodes and unknown nodes as the radius of the cubes which are used for centroid estimate, and then evaluate location of the unknown nodes according to the intersection of the cubes. And the results of the simulation proved that this algorithm is more accurate and less complex compared with DV-Hop and Bounding Cube, thus it can meet the demand on location algorithm better.

articleTitle: Profound Influences of Evolution of Management Theories on Development of Accounting Science
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Reflection and embodiment of management thoughts in the sector of accounting science enrich and promote the development of accounting theories and, under some circumstances, guide practices of accounting. Accounting practices and formation of accounting theories are inseparable from the needs of management practices. This paper believes that each internal change of management thoughts has profound influences on accounting theories, promoting the prosperity and scientific and overall development of accounting practices.

articleTitle: Logistics Performance Evaluation of Logistics Enterprise Integrated with KPIs and FAHP Model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: This paper will take a logistics company for example, and analyze its operation situations firstly. And then we try to build the system of performance evaluation index based on the KPIs method. Thirdly, this paper calculates the weight of evaluation index by fuzzy analytic hierarchy process method (FAHP), and tries to evaluate the logistics performance of this company. Result of example has proved that KPIs and FAHP model can be used to evaluate the logistics performance of logistics enterprise, and analysis process is very effective.

articleTitle: Compression Algorithm for Aeroengine Test Data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: A method to compress aeroengine test data is discussed in this paper. Three characteristics of test data are analyzed firstly. They are limited value range, limited variation range and limited value precision. Based on the characteristics, four processes including reducing decimal digits, eliding sign bit, eliding repeated value and eliding redundant coding bits are utilized to compress the data. Additional information needed for compression and decompression are discussed too in this paper. Two compression examples with real aeroengine test data show that the method can compress test data to very low compression ratio.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Study of Growth of Energy-Saving Building Based on Cascade Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The energy-saving gap of building is serious. In practical matters of building engineering, the input process of time-varying system can be divided into several stages. In every stage, the system has its own rules and features. At present, various evaluation methods are slow in solving this matter. Cascade neural network can properly describe the growth continuity of each part of building energy-saving. In this paper, we applied cascade neural network to the growth evaluation of building energy-saving to effectively monitor whether building energy-saving is out of joint.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The Research on Institutional Factors Upgrading of Enterprises in Chinese Industrial Clusters
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Optimal Design for Facility Workshop Layout Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Based on the study of the workshop layout, aiming at minimizing "transportation distance", the mathematical model of the workshop layout is established, and the optimal design of workshop layout is achieved by using the genetic algorithm with penalty function. Through the calculation of a living example, the validity and feasibility of the algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Construction and Integration of Recycling Enterprises' Value Chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The Appraisal Tactics for Internal Cost and Its Numerical Simulation Based on Real Data
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Based on the hypothesis of rational decision and take sintering ore blending problem of an iron & steel company as example, the paper firstly formulated the optimizing ore blending problem as a linear programming model under the goal of minimizing the internal material price and market material price, respectively. Then it numerically simulated the dynamic enterprises' internal cost assessing criterion under market price, analyzes the difference between global and local cost with diversified adjustment schemes of internal cost criterion. At last, it provides some adjustment proposals for internal cost assessing criterion.

articleTitle: Managing Expertise: Toward the Socio-Technical Perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The future trend of knowledge management will reflect how knowledge is produced and integrated in human social systems. The objective of knowledge management is to enhance knowledge processing. Expertise or expert knowledge is a vital resource of which decision makers need to become much more aware. This paper synthesizes the evolution of research on expertise from an interdisciplinary perspective and shows what managerial problems of handling divergent forms of expertise or expert knowledge are. It also discusses the development of related expertise management technologies and draws attention to the gap with the social science research. We develop an expertise life cycle (ELC) model supported by expertise management system architecture to bridge the gap.

articleTitle: A Research to Data Management in Savant Based on Data Grid
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Internet of things (IoT) has been researched in recently years. The Savant as a midware provides the data collecting and pre-processing for the IoT applications. Data grid can aggregate the resources in the IoT. Using data grid to build the Savant enables the Savant manage large scale data and optimizes the efficiency of the resources in IoT. In this paper, the data in the IoT is classified, and a data grid based Savant is designed. In addition, the key issue of data replication strategy is analyzed, and a advanced cascading strategy is proposed according to the features of the Savant. After the simulation to the strategy, In the simulation of the data replication strategy, the performance of the advanced cascading is lower than that of the cascading by 3.6%. However, the bandwidth consumption and the storage occupation are brought down by 12.5% and 25.9%.

articleTitle: Study on Simulation Model of Combination Station for Heavy Haul Trains
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: It is a new subject to calculate combining capacity of combination station for heavy haul trains. The paper compared the differences between combination stations and common marshalling stations, and pointed out the particularities of station arranging type, operation features, and operation process of trains in combination station. Based on statistical analysis of data to gain the probably distribution of operation times by using SPSS, the paper established the carrying capacity simulation model of combination station, and put forward a new method based on realization probability for computing the station carrying capacity. Finally, Hudong station in Daqin railway taken as an example, application of the model and method was illustrated and the results were analyzed in detail.

articleTitle: Connectivity as a Service: Outsourcing Enterprise Connectivity over Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: Today, the emergence and booming of Cloud Computing brings unprecedented impact to traditional enterprise connectivity market at the same time of bringing huge impact to IT architecture and enterprise computing environment. The requirements of integrating numerous on premise application and off premise application or service, and the IT cost effect coming with Cloud Computing lead enterprise expediting the mindset changes from the on premise ESB architecture to Cloud Computing oriented enterprise computing, that is Connectivity as a Service (CaaS). We argue in this paper that the outsourcing enterprise connectivity over Cloud Computing environment to construct CaaS has been becoming an unavoidable tendency to be adopted by enterprise users. We firstly have an overview of history and current status of enterprise connectivity in the beginning of the paper and then highlight the problems to be tackled in this field currently, following which we present one CaaS reference model and the corresponding conceptual architecture. We then explore in more details on their characteristics in critical perspectives and finally solidify our vision by carrying out one case study on CaaS in actual usage.

articleTitle: A Service-Oriented Architecture Suite for Sensor Management in Distributed Surveillance Systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: The increased popularity of the proactive security paradigm aggravated the need for distributed surveillance systems. These systems are built using smart sensor networks which cover large areas of civilian concentration. Such networks need intelligent management systems to control the large number of sensor nodes and the large volume of data. Sensor Management Frameworks (SMF) aim to coordinate the sensor nodes in a manner that improves the process of system control and situation awareness. Most SMFs proposed in literature are point solutions that do not use generic development architectures to allow reusability and extendability of different research projects. This work introduces an organizational development suite based on the service-oriented architecture to address the requirements of SMF from a stacked layer perspective. Furthermore, this paper discusses the important functional properties of such systems, and categorizes these functional properties according to their processing level. A case study was proposed that shows the extendability and reusability of the proposed organizational suite.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Factors Affecting SO2 Emission of Chinese Industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: This paper integrates Grossman decomposition model with Logarithmic Mean Divisia Index (LMDI) Decomposition method to construct a new decomposition model concerning industrial pollution factors. We decompose the influencing factors with the constructed model which selects year 2005 to 2008 as analysis period and Chinese industries and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission of its internal industries as research object. For Chinese industry and its domains, the dominant influencing factor of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission is scale effect in analysis period. The variation of scale goes against the reduction of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, whereas structural variation benefits that. Improve the clean technology effect or pollution treatment effect is two effective ways of reducing SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission. Only by lowering down the emission of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> of leading domains, the reduction effect can be more obvious.

articleTitle: Storage System Optimization in Data-Intensive Environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: With the repaid development of multi-media and network, information are generated and spread quickly than before. New application such as search engine, video share depends on the scale and access speed of huge data set. Data-intensive computing became a hot point of computer science. In Data-intensive environments, data access ability is the bottleneck instead of computing ability. In this paper, we present a framework to manage data distribute and recent research results to accelerate data access in data-intensive environment.

articleTitle: Exchange Rate Pass-Through to Import and Export Prices: Empirical Analysis in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Computer and Management (CAMAN)
abstract: This paper conducts empirical analysis on exchange rate pass-through to import and export prices in China with monthly data from 1999 to 2008, and finds that exchange rate pass-through is higher to export prices than to import prices. The analysis shows that the difference in the pass-through of exchange rate to import and export prices arises from the difference in industrial margin, international treaties and trade barrier. Based on empirical results and China's sustained trade surplus, this paper concludes that the demand elasticity of China's export is small due to strong competitive edges in price of China's export products, so the appreciation of RMB will do little in reducing China's foreign trade surplus.
